assets.resources_present.desc: 静态资源定位入口的路径常量(I18N_CATALOG_DIR/I18N_TEXTS_DIR/EDITOR_FRONTEND_DIR)指向 gbc/assets/ 下真实存在且已填充的资源目录——catalog 含默认语言 en.json、texts 含 rules、editor 含 index.html 及零构建多文件前端结构(app.js/i18n.js + js/*.js + css/*.css)。守「资源被移走/丢失却忘改常量」的回归；也是打包(package-data 覆盖 assets/**)的源码侧前置。

DOCS_DIR.offline_manual.desc: DOCS_DIR exposes all fixed English and Chinese manual topics independent of cwd; installed package resources take precedence, source fallback is anchored only to this package checkout with the GBC project marker.
